name: WingRiders
description: Constant-product AMM DEX built on Cardano's eUTxO model, with dedicated stableswap pools for pegged assets. LP positions accrue ADA staking rewards alongside trading fees.
notes: Asset list is based on the stableswap pairs named on WingRiders' own product pages (USDC, USDT, DJED, iUSD) plus ADA and the WRT governance token. Concentrated-liquidity pools were proposed in a 2023 Catalyst proposal but no evidence was found that they shipped. Scripts captured from real unsigned transactions on 2026-10-14 and confirmed on chain; a route through a contract not listed here is refused by the signer guard.
